concept: Two white eggs in glazed ink-black egg cups on a lilac sweep, rendered in 3D (Blender). Each shell carries a red ink stamp the way UK eggs carry a date, but the stamp is a website footer: one says (c) 2019, the other (c) 2026. Which one's fresh? Then right up against the 2019 stamp: your footer says 2019. Then the 2026 egg on its own: change one number, or set it to change itself. Lilac, eggshell white, ink-black glaze and one red ink.
